chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Ma'mar ibn Yahya and Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: There is no Salat on the day of al-Fitr and al-Adha except with an Imam.

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ: Eid al-Fitr (Festival of Breaking the Fast)

ai.seo_question: Is Eid prayer valid without an Imam in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes that the Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha prayers are exclusively valid when performed in congregation with an Imam, highlighting their status as public acts of worship rather than individual obligations. This ruling underscores the communal and political dimension of Eid in Shia jurisprudence, where the Imam’s presence signifies the unity of the Muslim community under his leadership.
